subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'x' sound at the beginning of words

show.line: Listen. x says ks. Fox. Box. Six. Hear the x at the end? Fox!

rounds.prompt: Which one ends with x, as in fox?
Say the sound with me. x says ks!

rounds.story: Max has a big box. A small fox hides inside. Big box, small fox! What hides in the box?

rounds.prompt: Which number ends with x? Count the dots.
What is this? It ends with x.
Does it end with x? Put x words in the x group.

hints: Listen to the end of the word. Fox. Box. ks!
x says ks. Say it fast. ks, ks.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that ends with x.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Hat ends with t. Fox ends with x.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Fox. Fox ends with x!

parent_line: Can hear the x sound in words like fox and box.
